metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire detections than Thailand between August 2016 and February 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Collection: Use "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" (Terra daily thermal anomalies/fire) for active fires. Date: 2016-08-01 to 2018-02-28, covering August 2016 – February 2018. Location: Cambodia and Thailand countries (use public EE feature collections). 2. Masking: The "FireMask" band values 7–9 indicate fire (confidence nominal/high). Create a binary mask (1 = fire, 0 = no-fire). Sum the masked image per country over the period to get total active-fire pixels. 3. Check empty collection (C1), then count valid pixels (C2). Compare totals; if totals are equal or difference is 0 use B (No). If Thailand > Cambodia → B (No). If Cambodia > Thailand → A (Yes). Null totals → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time cam = ee.FeatureCollection("FAO/GAUL/0/level0").filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Cambodia')).geometry() tha = ee.FeatureCollection("FAO/GAUL/0/level0").filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Thailand')).geometry() period = ee.Filter.date('2016-08-01', '2018-02-28') # 2. Data Acquisition & Check col = ee.ImageCollection("MODIS/006/MOD14A1").filter(period) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No fire images found.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Mask fires (FireMask 7–9 = valid fire) fire = col.map(lambda img: img.select('FireMask').gte(7).rename('fire')) totCam = fire.sum().reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=cam, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('fire').getInfo() totTha = fire.sum().reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=tha, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('fire').getInfo() # 4. Validation if totCam is None or totTha is None: print("Calculation failure.") print("C3") elif (totCam == 0) and (totTha == 0): print("No valid fire pixels.") print("C2") else: print(f"Cambodia fires: {int(totCam)}, Thailand fires: {int(totTha)}") if totCam > totTha: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
cam = ee.FeatureCollection("FAO/GAUL/0/level0").filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Cambodia')).geometry()
tha = ee.FeatureCollection("FAO/GAUL/0/level0").filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Thailand')).geometry()
period = ee.Filter.date('2016-08-01', '2018-02-28')

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
col = ee.ImageCollection("MODIS/006/MOD14A1").filter(period)
if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No fire images found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Mask fires (FireMask 7–9 = valid fire)
fire = col.map(lambda img: img.select('FireMask').gte(7).rename('fire'))
totCam = fire.sum().reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=cam, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('fire').getInfo()
totTha = fire.sum().reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=tha, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('fire').getInfo()

# 4. Validation
if totCam is None or totTha is None:
    print("Calculation failure.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif (totCam == 0) and (totTha == 0):
    print("No valid fire pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Cambodia fires: {int(totCam)}, Thailand fires: {int(totTha)}")
    if totCam > totTha:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
